shortcutHelp.label: Move between controls
shortcutHelp.description: From search, jump to the selected chat, then continue through its controls. Shift+Tab moves back.

shortcutHelp.label: Select a chat
shortcutHelp.description: In search or the conversation list, move to the previous or next chat.

shortcutHelp.label: Open the selected chat
shortcutHelp.description: In search or on a chat row, open that chat. In the paste picker, send the copied text to it.

shortcutHelp.label: Rename a chat
shortcutHelp.description: On a selected chat that supports rename, edit its name.

shortcutHelp.label: Close or go back
shortcutHelp.description: Close the current sheet, question or menu first. Otherwise leave the paste picker, clear search, then hide the panel.

shortcutHelp.label: Send copied text
shortcutHelp.description: While the panel is open, enter or leave the chat picker for copied text.

shortcutHelp.label: Show keyboard shortcuts
shortcutHelp.description: With the normal conversation list focused and search empty, open this sheet.

items.label: Answer permission requests from the companion
items.hint: Approve or deny requests on the chat row. You can still answer in the terminal.

items.label: Ask me before an agent sends a message
items.hint: Holds each message an agent sends until you approve it in the thread.

items.label: Send copied text
items.hint: Change the shortcut that opens the list to send what you copied

items.label: Check for updates
items.hint: Looks for a newer release. When one is known, updates the app and its command line tool, then restarts it.

items.label: Check for updates automatically
items.hint: Checks once a day while the companion runs. Check for updates works either way.

items.label: Hide Agnostic AI companion
items.hint: Takes the circle and the list off the screen. The shortcut brings them back. The circle comes back faded on its own when something new waits.

items.label: Quit Agnostic AI companion
items.hint: Asks first, then ends the program. The shortcut stops working until you start it again with agnostic-ai companion.
